name: Kabir
reframe: he reads what no one else can
physical_description: 10-year-old South Asian boy, short cropped hair, green bomber jacket over a white tee, cargo shorts, a canvas satchel covered in patches
strengths: sees shapes and space in three dimensions
remembers anything he has heard once
vulnerabilities: reading aloud in front of people
fear_carried_in: that slow at reading means slow at everything
story_premise: an old map of the school tunnels only makes sense when the letters move, and the one kid whose letters always move is the only one who can follow it
totem: a folding ruler he clicks open and shut
